collegeInfo: School of Business Management, NMIMS Navi Mumbai (SBM NMIMS) is a fast-growing, industry-orientated B-school, recognized for its innovative curriculum, vibrant campus life, and placement success. Situated in the planned city of Navi Mumbai, it leverages the strong NMIMS brand and Mumbai's corporate connect.

events.eventFullDescription: Euphoria is SBM NMIMS Navi Mumbai's flagship management and cultural fest, drawing participation from top B-schools and undergraduate colleges. The event features business plan competitions, management quizzes, live case studies, cultural shows, and workshops.

Meraki is an industry-academia HR conclave organized by SBM NMIMS Navi Mumbai. It brings HR leaders and professionals together for panel discussions, keynote speeches, and interaction sessions with students.

collegeName: Narsee Monjee Institute of Management Studies

infrastructure.infraDescription:
SBM NMIMS Navi Mumbai boasts a contemporary, fully Wi-Fi enabled campus with state-of-the-art classrooms, finance/analytics labs, and a well-stocked library. Hostel accommodation is available for both men and women. Recreational facilities include sports grounds, indoor games rooms, cafeteria, and a gymnasium.

Academic Infrastructure🏫

  • Smart classrooms with AV systems and interactive boards.

  • Library with online databases and study spaces.

Residential Facilities🏨

  • On-campus hostels with mess and laundry services for both boys and girls.

Recreation & Amenities☕

  • Multi-cuisine cafeteria and coffee outlets on campus.

  • Sports fields, gym, and indoor games.
